strengths: Chapters are organized around uncertainty centers rather than equal character rotation.
The six core arcs remain distinct while secondary-ring characters enter only where they reveal a system or relationship the core actor cannot see alone.
Housing, employment, research and organizational judgment recur at different life stages, allowing delayed consequence rather than one-off thematic scenes.
The ending remains ordinary and does not retrospectively rank the cast.
problems: Part 2 is overly concentrated in 2031 and underrepresents the lived transition through 2029-2030.
Part 4 contains many mature decisions in succession; without errands, waiting, routine work and failed small interactions the cast could appear implausibly self-aware.
Work and research scenes remain structurally dominant; domestic and city texture must enter inside chapters even when they do not create separate plot beats.
The viewpoint summary note in v1 is imprecise: its counts include primary plus mirror viewpoint blocks, not primary viewpoints only.

new_chapter.visible_action: 林静完成答辩后的边界修改，拒绝同时打开求职和新研究问题；学位程序闭环后，才和陈岚一起把城市、收入、响应边界、并行任务和学习价值写成第一轮职业筛选条件。
new_chapter.hidden_contradiction: 她长期把自主理解成保护研究空间，但博士真正结束时，首先需要的是接受一个阶段可以被有限地关掉。
new_chapter.material_or_institutional_constraint: 学位程序、明确修改项、时间窗口、求职信息噪声和毕业后的现金/城市约束。
new_chapter.unresolved_residue: 学位关掉以后没有职位自动出现；职业搜索这时才真正开始。
new_chapter.rhythm: 低戏剧、纸面工作、等待程序、几次普通见面；不要把毕业写成重生。
new_chapter.anti_ai_risk: 避免‘一扇门关闭另一扇门打开’类隐喻。

required_revision.renumber_rule: All v1 chapters 6-23 shift by +1; final count becomes 24.

part4_texture_rules: Every Part 4 chapter must contain at least one activity unrelated to the headline decision: commute, lunch, document cleanup, routine task, shopping, family message or waiting.
At least two Part 4 chapters should end because time or another obligation interrupts the scene, not because the character reaches a conclusion.
Do not make every mature decision articulate. Some characters can act correctly for reasons they explain poorly.
Retain one minor mistake or miscommunication in at least half of Part 4 chapters so maturity does not become omniscience.

corrected_viewpoint_block_counts_after_r.counting_rule: Primary and mirror viewpoint blocks are counted; a mirror block is normally shorter and does not imply equal chapter weight.

recommendation: Treat the 24-chapter map as provisional architecture. Draft one full pilot chapter using v2 chapter 3 before drafting chapter 1; the pilot is a voice and density test, not a commitment to opening order.
